mapper.insert: insert into Chats (user1_id, user2_id, salon_id) values (#{user1Id}, #{user2Id}, #{salonId})
mapper.select: select c.chat_id, c.salon_id, s.salon_name, s.image_url as salon_image_url, c.user2_id as partner_id, u.user_name as partner_name, (select m.message_content from Messages m where m.chat_id = c.chat_id order by m.message_id desc limit 1) as last_message, (select m.sent_at from Messages m where m.chat_id = c.chat_id order by m.message_id desc limit 1) as last_message_at, (select count(*) from Messages m where m.chat_id = c.chat_id and m.sender_id = c.user2_id and m.is_read = 0) as unread_count from Chats c join Salons s on s.salon_id = c.salon_id join Users u on u.user_id = c.user2_id where c.user1_id = #{customerId} order by c.updated_at desc

select c.chat_id, c.salon_id, s.salon_name, s.image_url as salon_image_url, c.user1_id as partner_id, u.user_name as partner_name, (select m.message_content from Messages m where m.chat_id = c.chat_id order by m.message_id desc limit 1) as last_message, (select m.sent_at from Messages m where m.chat_id = c.chat_id order by m.message_id desc limit 1) as last_message_at, (select count(*) from Messages m where m.chat_id = c.chat_id and m.sender_id = c.user1_id and m.is_read = 0) as unread_count from Chats c join Salons s on s.salon_id = c.salon_id join Users u on u.user_id = c.user1_id where c.salon_id = #{salonId} order by c.updated_at desc
mapper.update: update Chats set updated_at = now() where chat_id = #{chatId}
mapper.insert: insert into Messages (chat_id, sender_id, message_content) values (#{chatId}, #{senderId}, #{messageContent})
mapper.select: select m.message_id, m.chat_id, m.sender_id, m.message_content, m.is_read, m.sent_at, u.user_name as sender_name from Messages m join Users u on u.user_id = m.sender_id where m.chat_id = #{chatId} order by m.message_id asc
select count(*) from Messages m join Chats c on c.chat_id = m.chat_id where (c.user1_id = #{userId} or c.user2_id = #{userId}) and m.sender_id != #{userId} and m.is_read = 0
